name: diagnosis lovesick
source:
You wake up in a strange hospital with no memory of how you got there.

There, you meet Cry Bunny, a cheerful rabbit loving nurse... well, the only nurse here.

But you're not alone.

Two other patients, Tilly and Lucy, fill the strange hospital with color, laughter, and life.

You're promised that you'll be able to leave once you get better...

Whatever that means.

Until then, why not spend some time with the other patients? Make some memories, get to know your silly rabbit nurse, and perhaps....

[s]Uncover the secrets hidden within the hospital.[/s]

[From [url=https://ubaepeach.itch.io/diagnosis-lovesick]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在一家古怪的医院里醒来，完全不记得自己是怎么来到这里的。

在医院里，你遇见了开朗活泼、酷爱兔子的护士“爱哭兔”……好吧，她也是这儿唯一的护士。

但你并非孤身一人。

另外两名病友蒂莉与露西，为这座冷清古怪的医院注入了色彩、欢笑与生机。

院方承诺，只要你康复好转就能出院离开……

鬼知道那到底是什么意思。

在那之前，不妨多陪陪其他病友吧？留下一段段美好回忆，深入了解你那傻乎乎的兔子护士，或许还能……

[s]揭开潜藏在医院深处的秘密。[/s]

[摘自[url=https://ubaepeach.itch.io/diagnosis-lovesick]itch.io[/url]]
